name: Dimension Door, Greater
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level bard 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner/unchained summoner 5, witch 5

CASTING

Duration 1 round/2 levels

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like dimension door, except as noted above and that you can transfer yourself and the targets once per round, up to the spell’s range, as a move action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
